summary: Five qualified, unique executed industrial leases in Columbus within 8 miles with event dates between 2025-09-01 and 2026-08-31 were selected and ranked by distance ascending: R2732 (0.80 mi, 11.28 $/sf/yr effective net), R7377 (1.03 mi, 16.93), R7850 (1.26 mi, 19.41), R9286 (1.49 mi, 9.47) and R9636 (1.72 mi, 22.12). Average effective net rent across the set is 15.84 $/sf/yr (range 9.47-22.12). Controlling updates: executed amendment U-R7377-1 (free rent 4 months, TI $18) applied; unsigned draft U-R9286-3 and post-cutoff amendment U-R7850-2 rejected. R5958 was collapsed as a duplicate of R2732 (entity CYPRESS-REN-54094). Two further records (R1188 at 1.95 mi, R2670 at 2.18 mi) also qualify but fall outside the top five by distance. A comp-grid XLSX with live formulas and citations was produced (artifacts/underwriting-v1.xlsx).
limitations: Effective rents use the client's undiscounted rent-only convention (annual escalations at months 13/25/37/49, free rent at the then-current face rate, gross expenses charged every month, TI subtracted once); results are not discounted cash flows or a market appraisal.

Wide dispersion (9.47 to 22.12 $/sf/yr) is driven mainly by expense basis and TI/free-rent packages rather than by location; gross comps R2732 and R9286 carry a $6.25/sf expense deduction while NNN comps carry none.

Distances are as supplied in the extracts; no submarket, building class, clear height, tenant credit, renewal-vs-new or escalation-structure detail is available, so quality adjustments were not possible.
annual_expenses_psf and ti_allowance_psf are null for several records and were treated as unknown (not zero), which excluded R5587, R1369 and R7843 rather than downgrading them.
R7850's face rent could change to $2.00 (unit unstated in the update) once U-R7850-2 becomes effective 2026-09-10; that post-cutoff amendment is excluded here.
R9286's effective rent would fall further if the unsigned 8-month free-rent draft (U-R9286-3) is later executed.
Duplicate detection relies on matching entity_id and terms; other undisclosed duplicates cannot be ruled out.
No contact, ownership or sponsor information was supplied or asserted.
